title: Hausdorff measure of a blow-up inside a ball (scaling of H^n under η_{x,r})
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^P, r > 0, R ∈ ℝ and S ⊆ ℝ^P (arbitrary). With η_{x,r}(z) = r⁻¹(z − x) (SimonGMT Chapter03.blowUpMap x r) and H^n = μHE[n]: H^n(η_{x,r}(S) ∩ closedBall(0, R)) = (ENNReal.ofReal r)⁻¹^n · H^n(S ∩ closedBall(x, r·R)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (x : Euclid P) (r R : ℝ) (S : Set (Euclid P)), 0 < r → μHE[n] (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' S ∩ closedBall 0 R) = (ENNReal.ofReal r)⁻¹ ^ n * μHE[n] (S ∩ closedBall x (r * R))
